earlier_run_checks.cloud_comparison_note: Cloud attachment contains aggregates only. Clean prediction equality does not guarantee identical corrupted-input scores; local rerun values are retained without modification.
earlier_run_checks.noise_comparison: White-noise draws and DEMAND offsets changed; earlier noise results are retained as a separate protocol version.

aggregation: Accuracy and macro-F1 computed in each official fold, then averaged; macro-F1 uses all 50 labels and zero_division=0. Capture is pooled errors predicted as distractor / pooled errors.
strata_rule: The same target clips are used for semantic, DEMAND and clean within each stratum, model and level, and across both power definitions. Bins use the unchanged own-manifest overlap.
accuracy_decomposition_rule: Additive contributions to pooled accuracy differences over matched targets; distinct from the main table's equal-weight fold-mean accuracy.
limitations: Overlap strata have different class and difficulty distributions; F1 is nonlinear, so full-set F1 is not a weighted average of stratum F1.

Stratum macro-F1 retains all 50 labels, including classes absent from individual folds. Do not infer relative baseline difficulty from cross-stratum macro-F1; inspect class coverage and clean accuracy.
Neither stratification nor power normalization isolates semantic meaning from temporal/spectral acoustics.
Target-region scaling can amplify non-overlapping events and attenuate the target; use gain-matched controls.
One fixed CNN training seed; no significance claim or bootstrap interval in this comparison.
0 dB is a diagnostic stress test, not an unambiguous single-label mixture.
